gpt-5-mini.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1971 commenced underwriting in 2019 and therefore had no opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2019. The syndicate established gross claims provisions at year end (31 December 2019) including an IBNR margin in excess of the actuarial best estimate to allow for reserving uncertainty in this new line of business. No quantifiable prior-year reserve movement is reported because 2019 is the first year of underwriting.
raw_causal_phrases: we have made a provision within claims that have been incurred at the reporting date but have not yet been reported ("IBNR") in the calendar year to allow for this reserving uncertainty.
This provision is in excess of our best estimate for claims costs which is in line with our original business plan.
The reported result reflects the level of reserving for the business written. As a new class of liability business in an evolving area data is limited and the reserving is highly judgemental.
